Essence of a Broken Dream begins a quest chain that eventually rewards the Incandescent Essence. To begin, defeat Gnarlroot and loot the Twisted Dreaming Essence from its corpse. Turn in to Merithra, who is located inside the raid.

Two Etched Carvings can be found in the at . Reading one as a Mage will cause a series of green circles to appear. Use Blink to move through the circles to the other carving without taking any steps, and read it to learn the Living Bomb (mage rune) rune.

The Essence of the Eastern Kingdoms is created by combining 20 , which have a chance to drop from Radiant Echoes objectives in the Searing Gorge. This item can in turn be combined with the Lifeless Stone Ring along with the other essences (Essence of Kalimdor and the Essence of Northrend) to create a Band of Radiant Echoes, an heirloom ring.

The Essence of Northrend is created by combining 20 , which have a chance to drop from Radiant Echoes objectives in the Dragonblight. This item can in turn be combined with the Lifeless Stone Ring along with the other essences (Essence of Kalimdor and the Essence of the Eastern Kingdoms) to create a Band of Radiant Echoes, an heirloom ring.

The Essence of Kalimdor is created by combining 20 , which have a chance to drop from Radiant Echoes objectives in Dustwallow Marsh. This item can in turn be combined with the Lifeless Stone Ring along with the other essences (Essence of the Eastern Kingdoms and the Essence of Northrend) to create a Band of Radiant Echoes, an heirloom ring.

Eternal Palace sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 8.2.0 and the Eternal Palace. They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Eternal Palace appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 24. Completing one of these sets will grant the Under the Seams achievement.

Eternal Curator's Protectorate is the Uldir set for plate-wearers. Several items can count towards collecting the appearance for each armor slot. Zandalar and Kul Tiras world bosses, along with a few pieces that can be crafted with Battle for Azeroth Blacksmithing, can unlock the normal difficulty appearance. Completing the set grants the New Mog, G'huun This? achievement.
